text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon was really starting to look 
the part as the Winning Live's center.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gaining recognition as a promising dirt 
Umamusume, even bloggers are starting to 
take notice of her Winning Lives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The term "Umadol" was starting to catch 
on. Smart Falcon pushes forward toward her 
dream of becoming the top Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, as she aimed for the top of the 
dirt division, it was expected that she 
wouldn't run in the turf Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"It's a shame we won't get to see Falco's 
full-power live on the grand Triple Crown 
stage." Smart Falcon overheard those words 
from the fans.
